purpose: Prevent downstream 1943Q3/Q4 and 1944 material from silently becoming Branch B history.
rules: Do not import any realized event after 1943-07-31 unless re-adjudicated in Branch B.
Later tech ledgers may be used only through their date-gated entries valid by the event date.
The GALVANIC mandatory-factors memo is a methodological checklist only; its implied November sequence is not history.
Indian Ocean/Arakan operation may be reconsidered from scratch among other strategic choices; its later study does not grant preparation, allocation, or GO.
US carrier regeneration must be forecast from branch losses and industrial/training clock; old US carriers remain lost.
